caseName: Fidelity Title & Trust Co. v. Dubois Electric Co.
caseNameFull: Fidelity Title & Trust Company, Ancillary Administrator, etc. v. Dubois Electric Company
attorneys: Mr. Marcus W. Acheson, Jr., for petitioner. See post, 606.

opinions.text: The motion to reinstate the petition for certiorari, in accordance with the reservation to that effect in the order of March 24, 1919, is allowed. It is ordered that the writ of certiorari be, and the same is hereby, granted.
